name: Chase Fraud Alerts
summary: This is not a person. It's Chase Bank's automated fraud-alert short code (72166). Every incoming message is a card-decline or transaction-confirmation alert, and the phone owner only ever replies 'Yes' to confirm charges. There are no client, business-line or personal signals, so it should be saved as a bank service contact rather than a lead.
key_facts: Automated Chase Bank fraud alert short code 72166, not a human contact
Owner replies YES to confirm flagged transactions
Alerts cover several Chase cards (ending 3845, 6823, 1342, 2764, 6705, 6731) and account ending 9703
Card ending 6731 is the most active card in recent months (Jun-Oct 2026)
Repeated Coinbase purchases via card are blocked; Chase says to use ACH instead
Flagged merchants include OnlyFans, Anthropic Claude, Apify, Higgsfield, LeakCleaner, Supalink.ai and Envato (possible business tooling expenses)
